entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 130:2
segments: Lord, hear my voice:  Let thine ears be attentive  To the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities,  O Lord, who could stand?

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: But there is forgiveness with thee,  That thou mayest be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait,  And in his word do I hope.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord More than watchmen [wait] for the morning; [Yea, more than] watchmen for the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.

entries.title: Psalms 130:8
segments: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
